title: デビュー戦の後に・帝王、発進！

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hehe! ♪ Hey, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Don't I seem different to you? Like I've shed my immaturity and become an adult?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: It was amazing to finally have my debut and enter the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm ready to take on another race! I need to hurry and catch up with Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: All right, gotta train super hard starting tomorrow!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Teio finishes her debut race without a hitch. The next day…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm done with my run, Trainer! What's next on the list?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Teio, the rising star of the Twinkle Series, can handle any training you throw at her!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Well then. It seems like you had a satisfying debut.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ah, Air Groove! I'm in the Twinkle Series now too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She starts talking to Air Groove, who already has experience running in Twinkle Series races.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haha, indeed. You ran splendidly.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: However, you are merely standing at the starting line. The real race begins now, Teio.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ugh! I know that! I'm gonna win a whole bunch of races, just watch me!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Oh, speaking of which, do you want to do some partner running with me?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You and I? You've just finished your debut race. Aren't you pushing yourself a little too hard?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Not at all! I'm going to show you the true might of a rising star!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer. I can run with Air Groove, can't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Running with such a veteran racer could prove to be a valuable teaching moment for her…
choice_data_list: Learn as much as you can!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Yay! It's a race, then!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Show me just how strong you are after your debut.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Gasp… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Uuugh! I lost!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: You still need to learn about proper pacing and timing, it seems.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But that will come with time and experience. There is no questioning that you are powerful.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: And above all, you have that unrelenting drive in you.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: No wonder the president has taken a shine to you. That speed and strength of yours will only increase.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heh, that much is obvious! I'm aiming to surpass Prez after all!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haha. If you're serious about taking her on, then you must gain considerable power.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: But first, you'll be racing in the Classics, correct?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Of course! First, I gotta become the best of my peers.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I have to dominate the competition, which means I need to win all of the Classic Triple Crown races!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'll be a Triple Crown champion just like Prez!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Which means… Trainer! Enter me in the first Crown race! The Satsuki Sho!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just winning even one of the Classics is quite the challenge. So the first step is…
choice_data_list: First, we'll test you in the Wakagoma Stakes!
First, we'll test you in the Wakagoma Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Like a preliminary? Hmm… Well, I do want to see what my competition is like…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Okay! I'll do the Wakagoma Stakes first! And then it's straight into the Classics!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Haha. Once you finish your classic year, who knows how far you'll go. I look forward to seeing you grow.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Air Groove…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …You sound like a mom when you say things like that.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: What?! Do not spout such nonsense!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna win a lot of races and get even stronger, Mom!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Ack! I am not your mother!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With our eyes set on the Classics, we make our next goal the Wakagoma Stakes.
